_source: Reference limits from Washington State freshwater criteria (WAC 173-201A-200), assuming core summer salmonid habitat for temperature, salmonid spawning, rearing and migration for dissolved oxygen (provisional), and primary contact recreation for E. coli. Use designations differ by stream and these have not been approved for this project; confirm with the data owner. Edit this file to change them.

water_temperature.basis: Core summer salmonid habitat. The criterion is a 7-day average of daily maximums; a single reading only approximates it.

dissolved_oxygen.basis: Salmonid spawning, rearing and migration, lowest 1-day minimum. Provisional: the stricter core summer habitat limit is 9.5; confirm which applies with the data owner.

ecoli.basis: Primary contact recreation: no more than 10% of samples above 320 per 100 mL (the geometric mean limit is 100).
